title: NA-MT226-AnnotationGuiEvidenceSuite

scope.summary:
GOAL: Produce ONE consolidated, reproducible GUI evidence + regression suite covering every annotation surface built by MT-221..225, so a no-context model (or the WP validator) can prove the annotation UI works, is readable, is non-intrusive, and is keyboard-accessible — WITHOUT re-deriving how each surface behaves. Deliverables: Argus/AccessKit tree dumps for every new surface; a screenshot/snapshot baseline set spanning all annotation states, both editors, the panel, and the quarantine section; a renderer console/error scan; overlap + readability checks; a keyboard-only walkthrough script; all evidence written under the external artifacts root; and a regression harness runnable HEADLESS. This MT adds NO product surface — it exercises the surfaces MT-221..225 built. Interaction pattern reference: the existing native GUI proof harnesses (tests/native_gui_support/screenshot_harness.rs + argus_surface_proof.rs) and the focus-audit tests — extend those, do not invent a parallel evidence framework.

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE: New tests/test_annotation_gui_evidence.rs (the headless-runnable regression entrypoint) + a tests/native_gui_support/annotation_evidence.rs helper module (capture matrix builder, AccessKit-tree dumper, overlap/readability asserts, keyboard-walkthrough driver), registered in tests/native_gui_support/mod.rs. Evidence outputs (PNG snapshots, AccessKit JSON dumps, a capture-matrix manifest) are written under the resolved HANDSHAKE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT via the existing visual_debugger/screenshot path — NOT committed into the repo. No product src/ edits; no backend; no legacy React.

DETAILED SPEC (evidence matrix, harness, checks):
1. CAPTURE MATRIX (binding coverage): the suite enumerates and captures every (surface x state x variant) cell — code-editor markers in plain view + SideBySide (both panes) + Inline + Merge (three panes) with all four AnnotationMarkerState values (Open/Resolved/Orphaned/Outdated); the unanchored strip; Notes highlights + margin markers in edit AND reading mode; the shared thread widget with operator + model badges (robot_id/session shown); the MT-223 panel with filters/sort/badge counts/empty/error states; the MT-224 authoring flows (create/edit/delete-confirm) and a keyboard-only walkthrough; the MT-225 live-arrival 'N new' + quarantine section. A manifest lists each cell and its evidence path; any deliberately-skipped cell records a not_applicable_reason (no silent gaps).
2. ARGUS / ACCESSKIT DUMPS: for each surface, call argus.inspect (mcp/argus.rs) to dump the live AccessKit tree and assert the stable author_ids named by MT-221..225 exist and are non-colliding (including SideBySide/split-pane instance-suffixed and scoped_author_id cases). argus.screenshot (focus-safe Win32 PrintWindow, mcp/screenshot.rs) captures pixels without stealing focus.
3. RENDERER CONSOLE / ERROR SCAN: capture and assert the egui/wgpu renderer produced no error/warn lines while rendering each surface (no panics, no missing-glyph/texture warnings) — a clean render log per cell.
4. OVERLAP + READABILITY: assert annotation glyphs do not obscure diagnostics/breakpoints/fold triangles (code editor) and margin markers do not collide with wikilink/inline-tag/transclusion geometry (Notes); assert marker states are shape-distinct (readable without color) and text-over-tint contrast holds in BOTH light and dark themes.
5. KEYBOARD-ONLY WALKTHROUGH: a scripted driver performs the full MT-224 authoring flow (create -> reply -> resolve -> delete-with-confirm) using only keyboard/AccessKit default-actions (no argus.click mouse path) and records the transcript as evidence; failure = any step unreachable without a mouse.
6. QUIET / NO-FOCUS-STEAL: a simulated MT-225 live arrival asserts focus, active window, and caret are unchanged, and that no popup/toast/modal appeared (reuse the focus-audit precedent).
7. HEADLESS + REPRODUCIBLE: the harness runs headless (offscreen render target) so CI / a no-context validator can run it without a visible desktop session; evidence paths are deterministic under HANDSHAKE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT and the manifest is machine-readable.

STEP-BY-STEP:
1. Read tests/native_gui_support/ (screenshot_harness.rs, argus_surface_proof.rs), mcp/argus.rs (argus.inspect/screenshot) + mcp/screenshot.rs (capture_handshake_window), visual_debugger/mod.rs (default_artifact_root / HANDSHAKE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT resolution + validate_external_artifact_root), tests/test_focus_audit_quiet.rs, and the author_id inventories declared by MT-221..225.
2. Build tests/native_gui_support/annotation_evidence.rs: capture-matrix enumerator, AccessKit-tree dumper + author_id assertions, overlap/readability asserts, renderer-log scan, keyboard-walkthrough driver, QUIET arrival check.
3. Write tests/test_annotation_gui_evidence.rs as the headless entrypoint that drives the matrix, writes the manifest + evidence under the artifacts root, and fails on any missing/regressed cell.
4. Register the helper in tests/native_gui_support/mod.rs; run headless; confirm the manifest + baseline set + dumps land under HANDSHAKE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT.
forbidden_paths: app/src/** (legacy React notes editor is scheduled for REMOVAL by MT-261..264 — never test/extend it)
src/frontend/handshake_native/src/** (evidence-only MT: NO product code edits; if a surface is unprovable, raise it as a defect against MT-221..225, do not patch product code here)
any path that writes evidence INTO the repo (evidence must land under the external HANDSHAKE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT, never committed)
acceptance_criteria: A single headless-runnable regression entrypoint (tests/test_annotation_gui_evidence.rs) drives a capture matrix covering every annotation surface x state x variant from MT-221..225; a machine-readable manifest lists each cell and its evidence path, with a recorded not_applicable_reason for any skipped cell (no silent gaps).

For every surface an argus.inspect AccessKit-tree dump is captured and asserts the stable author_ids from MT-221..225 exist and are non-colliding (instance-suffixed and scoped_author_id cases included).

A screenshot/snapshot baseline set is captured via argus.screenshot / the visual_debugger path for: code markers (plain/SideBySide/Inline/Merge x Open/Resolved/Orphaned/Outdated), unanchored strip, Notes highlights+markers (edit + reading), shared thread widget (operator+model badges), MT-223 panel (filters/sort/counts/empty/error), MT-224 authoring (create/edit/delete-confirm), MT-225 'N new' + quarantine.
A renderer console/error scan asserts no error/warn/panic lines per rendered cell.

Overlap + readability checks pass: annotation glyphs do not obscure diagnostics/breakpoints/fold triangles; margin markers do not collide with wikilink/inline-tag/transclusion geometry; states are shape-distinct; text-over-tint contrast holds in light AND dark themes.
A keyboard-only walkthrough completes the full MT-224 authoring flow with zero mouse (no argus.click) and records a transcript; any mouse-only step fails the suite.
A simulated MT-225 live arrival asserts unchanged focus/active-window/caret and no popup/toast/modal (QUIET).

The harness runs headless (offscreen render) and writes all evidence + the manifest under the resolved HANDSHAKE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT (validate_external_artifact_root: outside the repo); nothing is committed into the repo.
No product src/ files are modified (evidence-only); UserManual is not applicable to this MT.
proof_targets: test asserts the evidence manifest enumerates every MT-221..225 surface cell (or records not_applicable_reason) and every referenced evidence file exists under HANDSHAKE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT
! rg -n "src/frontend/handshake_native/src/" <this MT's changed file list> (grep-proof: no product src edits in the diff)

Argus evidence: the suite IS the Argus evidence — argus.inspect AccessKit dumps + argus.screenshot baselines + renderer-log scans + keyboard-walkthrough transcript + QUIET arrival check, all under the external HANDSHAKE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT with a machine-readable capture-matrix manifest
expected_tests: harness: capture-matrix enumerator yields one cell per (surface, state, variant) across MT-221..225 with no missing surface
harness: AccessKit author_id assertions pass for every surface incl. SideBySide instance-suffix + rich scoped_author_id
harness: renderer-log scan finds zero error/warn/panic per cell
harness: overlap/readability asserts (glyph co-occupancy, margin non-collision, shape-distinct states, light+dark contrast)
harness: keyboard-only authoring walkthrough completes with zero mouse events
harness: QUIET live-arrival check (focus/window/caret unchanged, no popup)
harness: manifest + evidence files exist under HANDSHAKE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT and the run is headless-clean
implementation_notes: Verified grounding 2026-07-21 (wtc-native-editors-v1): native GUI proof harnesses live in tests/native_gui_support/ (screenshot_harness.rs, argus_surface_proof.rs); Argus methods are argus.inspect/argus.click/argus.set_value/argus.screenshot (mcp/argus.rs) with author_id -> NodeId resolution via mcp/action.rs resolve_target (UiTreeSnapshot, MT-026); focus-safe capture is mcp/screenshot.rs capture_handshake_window (Win32 PrintWindow). HANDSHAKE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT resolves via visual_debugger/mod.rs default_artifact_root() (:480-499) with validate_external_artifact_root guarding it stays outside the repo; many tests already read it (test_focus_audit_quiet.rs:48, test_fems_interop_proofs.rs:93 asserts absolute).
This MT writes ONLY tests + evidence; it must NOT edit product src. If any surface cannot be proven, that is a DEFECT against the owning MT (221..225) to be raised, not patched here.
Reuse the existing focus-audit precedent (tests/test_focus_audit_quiet.rs) for the QUIET no-focus-steal arrival check rather than writing a new focus model.

accesskit 0.21.1 role vocabulary (from code_editor/panel.rs) bounds the author_id assertions: expect Role::Group/Button/CheckBox/TextInput/SearchInput/Label/ScrollView, never ToggleButton/SearchBox/TextCursor.

Headless: use the offscreen render target the existing screenshot_harness uses so a no-context validator/CI can run without a visible desktop; keep evidence paths deterministic under the artifacts root and the manifest machine-readable.

Cross-family seams (reference only): every author_id/surface inventory declared by MT-221 (markers/strip/thread), MT-222 (rich highlights/markers), MT-223 (panel), MT-224 (authoring), MT-225 (live/quarantine).

surfaces: code-editor markers (plain/SideBySide/Inline/Merge, all four states) under test
Notes highlights + margin markers (edit + reading) under test
shared thread widget (operator + model badges) under test
MT-224 authoring flows + keyboard walkthrough under test
MT-225 live 'N new' + quarantine section under test

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Evidence + regression suite only; it adds no operator-facing feature. The annotation manual entries are owned and updated by MT-223/MT-224/MT-225; this MT may assert those manual author_ids are live but authors no manual content.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Evidence/regression harness; it records GUI proof artifacts, not business FR events.

The suite consumes the visual_debugger structured state and the MT-221..225 diagnostics tiers as its assertion inputs, and emits a machine-readable capture-matrix manifest for no-context diagnosis of any regressed cell.
Headless test harness; no long-running child process to liveness-track.

risk_if_missed: The annotation UI ships without consolidated, reproducible proof: no-context validators must hand-verify each surface, readability/overlap/QUIET/keyboard regressions slip in silently, and there is no headless baseline to catch a future break — exactly the visual-regression gap the build rules require GUI MTs to close.

risks: RISK-1: Coverage illusion — the suite passes but silently omits surfaces/states (e.g. Merge three-pane, Orphaned, dark theme, quarantine), giving false confidence that everything is proven.
RISK-2: Evidence leaks into the repo — snapshots/dumps get written into the repo tree instead of the external artifacts root, bloating the repo and breaking portability.
RISK-3: Product-code patching — to make a surface 'pass', the evidence MT edits product src, hiding a real defect that belongs to MT-221..225.
RISK-4: Non-headless dependence — the harness needs a visible desktop/focus, so CI or a no-context validator cannot run it, defeating the reproducibility goal.
RISK-5: Stale author_id assertions — the suite asserts author_ids that drifted from the real MT-221..225 ids, so it passes against a fiction and misses actual breakage.
minimum_controls: CTRL-1 (RISK-1): The capture matrix is enumerated from an explicit surface x state x variant list; every cell is captured or records a not_applicable_reason; a manifest completeness assert fails on any missing cell.
CTRL-2 (RISK-2): All evidence paths resolve under HANDSHAKE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT via validate_external_artifact_root (outside the repo); a test asserts no evidence path is inside the repo root.
CTRL-3 (RISK-3): src/frontend/handshake_native/src/** is a forbidden path; the diff contains only tests; unprovable surfaces are raised as defects against the owning MT, not patched.
CTRL-4 (RISK-4): The harness uses the offscreen/headless render target from screenshot_harness; a headless CI-mode run is part of the proof.
CTRL-5 (RISK-5): author_id assertions are cross-checked against the live AccessKit tree via argus.inspect (resolve_target), so an assertion only passes if the id actually exists in the running UI.

Evidence-target inventories come from MT-221..225 author_id/surface declarations.
corrections: Evidence must be written under the EXTERNAL HANDSHAKE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT (validate_external_artifact_root guarantees it is outside the repo), never committed — matching how the existing GUI proof harnesses and focus-audit tests write their artifacts.
This MT is tests-only: it must not touch product src; an unprovable surface is a defect against MT-221..225, not something to fix inside the evidence suite.
